sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sutos was once ruled by Zan-Sutos, where he was renowned as a wise and just leader. However, he eventually came to believe that his leadership was costing the people their freedom. He bravely gave up his own power so that his people could be free. Unfortunately, he was murdered by rioters. Instead of his son, Grier, the rightful heir, becoming ruler, Zan-Sutos was soon succeeded by Zan-Gason, with Grier going into exile. Subsequently, Sutos fell into an endless onslaught of civil war. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Grier eventually joined the Organization and always vowed to return with his goal being to one day bring order and peace to Sutos.

Eventually, with the backing of his personal Organization army, Grier returned to Sutos, bringing it under Organization control and ending the civil war. The Governor of Sutos gave Grier the royal fighting Titan of Sutos, Megataur which he used to battle against Dante in a tense showdown. However, he explained to the Huntk team that he had returned to bring order and peace to the people after years of war between local warlords for power. The Huntik team, realising that his intentions were honourable, made peace with Grier, leaving him to rule of Sutos in peace. [S1E12]
